client_only_extensions.note: Stateful Dart-only lazy follow-up/cursor, not a wire DTO or canonical operation. Public events/nextEvent/start/abort/close and explicit count/byte limits; no JSON serialization, model facade or backend action.
Calls existing retrieve/events observation/input operations; preserves raw manual APIs and package HTTP policy.

dart_policies: Deep immutable typed input/options capture; SDKs do not both deep-copy user arrays.
Single-use Stream adapter and explicit sequential pull cursor; Stream break cancels local observation.
256 queued events/1MiB encoded JSON bounds; overflow fails explicitly.
Existing Dart HTTP retry eligibility stays unchanged: transient429 can retry POST;503/transport does not become retryable merely from a key.
Private StreamException retains setup/API/transport errors as explicit causes; local abort exposes its reason without automatic diagnostic leakage.
